canned.title: Refund policy
canned.body: Thanks for reaching out. Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase for unused items and within 14 days for opened ones. Once we receive the return scan from the carrier, the refund is issued automatically and lands on your card within 3-5 business days.

canned.title: Shipping delay
canned.body: Sorry about the wait on your order. Carrier tracking sometimes lags a day or two behind the actual movement of the package. I have asked the carrier for a trace and will update you here as soon as they respond.

canned.title: Password reset
canned.body: You can reset your password from the sign-in page via "Forgot password" — the email arrives within a minute or two. If it does not show up, check the spam folder and make sure the address matches the one on the account. Reply here if you are still locked out and I will reset it manually after an identity check.

canned.title: API rate limits
canned.body: The API allows 600 requests per minute per token, measured over a sliding window. Responses include X-RateLimit-Remaining so your client can back off before hitting a 429. For bulk work, batching into chunks of 50 with a short pause between them stays comfortably under the limit.

canned.title: Plan comparison
canned.body: Team is $12 per seat and covers shared inboxes, views and reporting. Business is $18 per seat and adds SSO, audit logs and priority support. Upgrades are prorated to the day, so you only pay the difference for the remainder of the current cycle.

canned.title: Closing thanks
canned.body: Glad that is sorted. I will close this ticket now, but replying to this email reopens it at any time — no need to start over. Thanks for your patience.

kb.title: Set up your first inbox view
kb.body: Views are saved filters over your tickets. Start with the built-in All, Unassigned, and My open views, then add your own by combining a status, a priority, and an assignee. Most small teams run one shared triage view plus a personal view per agent so nobody trips over each other.

kb.title: Keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet
kb.body: BaseDesk is keyboard-first. In the inbox, use j and k to move between tickets, Enter to open, e to solve, u to assign to yourself, and 1 to 4 to set priority. Inside a ticket, r focuses the reply box and n starts an internal note. Press ? anywhere to see the full list, or Ctrl/Cmd K to open the command palette.

kb.title: How refunds are processed
kb.body: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase for unused items and within 14 days for opened ones. Once the return scan comes back from the carrier, the refund is issued automatically and lands on the original card within 3 to 5 business days. Duplicate charges are refunded as soon as we can see both on our side.

kb.title: Update your VAT or tax ID
kb.body: Add or correct a VAT or tax ID from the billing profile before an invoice is generated. If an invoice was already cut without the ID, we can reissue it with the correct details and, where VAT was charged in error, raise a credit note for the difference. Reissued invoices appear in your billing history.

kb.title: Handling rate limits (429s)
kb.body: The API allows 600 requests per minute per token, measured over a sliding window. Every response includes an X-RateLimit-Remaining header so your client can back off before hitting a 429. For bulk work, batch into chunks of about 50 requests with a short pause between them to stay comfortably under the limit.

kb.title: Reset two-factor authentication
kb.body: If you have lost your authenticator and your backup codes, reply from the billing email on the account and include the last four digits of the card on file. After an identity check we reset 2FA and add an entry to the audit log. Set up fresh backup codes right after you are back in so this does not recur.
